entities.name: ArgJ-like sequence
observations: 413-aa query sequence has 45.8–47.9% identity and 94.4–95.2% query coverage to reviewed ArgJ homologs; evidence supports probable bifunctional arginine-biosynthesis acetyltransferase, not direct experimental validation of this query.
Reviewed ArgJ homologs catalyze N(2)-acetyl-L-ornithine + L-glutamate ⇌ N-acetyl-L-glutamate + L-ornithine (EC 2.3.1.35; RHEA:15349).
Reviewed ArgJ homologs also catalyze L-glutamate + acetyl-CoA ⇌ N-acetyl-L-glutamate + CoA + H(+) (EC 2.3.1.1; RHEA:24292).

entities.name: ArgJ transacetylation
observations: N(2)-acetyl-L-ornithine + L-glutamate ⇌ N-acetyl-L-glutamate + L-ornithine; RHEA:15349; assigned to the query by homology to curated ArgJ proteins.

entities.name: N-acetylglutamate synthesis
observations: L-glutamate + acetyl-CoA ⇌ N-acetyl-L-glutamate + CoA + H(+); RHEA:24292; assigned to the query by homology to curated ArgJ proteins.
